# Bake and catalogue IR

Hosts and emitters consume JSON, not `.pdl`. Nested frame and component-row shapes live in these schema files.

| Artefact | Discriminant | Schema file | Role |
|----------|--------------|-------------|------|
| **Bake** | `schemaKind: "bakedDesign"` | [`shared/schema/baked-design.json`](https://github.com/Mana-Machine-Ventures-Inc/pdl/blob/main/shared/schema/baked-design.json) | Literal trees for drawing (HTML, future native) |
| **Catalogue** | `kind: "componentCatalogue"` | [`shared/schema/component-catalogue.json`](https://github.com/Mana-Machine-Ventures-Inc/pdl/blob/main/shared/schema/component-catalogue.json) | Token graph + default/variant trees for codegen |
| **Resolved slice** | `schemaKind: "resolvedComponent"` | [`shared/schema/resolved-component.json`](https://github.com/Mana-Machine-Ventures-Inc/pdl/blob/main/shared/schema/resolved-component.json) | One component + trimmed `system` |
| **Injection pack** | (input JSON) | [`shared/schema/injection-pack.json`](https://github.com/Mana-Machine-Ventures-Inc/pdl/blob/main/shared/schema/injection-pack.json) | `pdl bakePack` / `validatePack` — not PDL syntax |

Language `schemaVersion` is **`1.0.0-beta`**. Regenerated with `npm run docs:gen`.

## `bakedDesign`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `schemaKind` | yes | const `bakedDesign` |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | const `1.0.0-beta` · string |
| `generatedAt` | yes | string |
| `provenance` | yes | object |
| `previewBackground` | no | string · Resolved CSS color; omitted when unset. |
| `components` | yes | object · map |

`components` values are baked instances: `name`, `rootKind`, optional `bakedParams`, `root` (literal frame tree). No `primitive:` / `semantic:` markers — those belong on the catalogue.

`npm run bakeSystem` / `bakeComponent` (and Rust `pdl bake*`) emit this shape.

## `componentCatalogue`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `kind` | yes | const `componentCatalogue` |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | const `1.0.0-beta` · string |
| `generatedAt` | yes | string |
| `theme` | no | string · Present only when catalogue was built with --theme. |
| `primitives` | no | object · map |
| `semantics` | no | object · map |
| `themes` | no | object · map |
| `typeStyles` | no | object · map |
| `variantTypes` | no | object · map |
| `samples` | no | object · Optional. Bank → entry → field → evaluated value. Empty arrays preserved. · map |
| `components` | yes | object · map |

On CLI output with `omitEmpty`, empty maps may be **absent**. Treat missing `primitives` / `semantics` / `themes` / `typeStyles` / `variantTypes` as `{}`. Empty arrays under `samples` / `fixtures` are **preserved**.

`npm run catalogue` / `graphSystem` emit this shape.

## `resolvedComponent`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `schemaKind` | yes | const `resolvedComponent` |
| `schemaVersion` | yes | const `1.0.0-beta` · string |
| `generatedAt` | yes | string |
| `entryPath` | yes | string |
| `primaryComponent` | yes | string |
| `paramOverrides` | no | object |
| `components` | yes | object · map |
| `system` | yes | object |

`npm run graphComponent` emits this shape.

## Injection pack

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `schemaVersion` | yes | const `1.0.0-beta` · string |
| `component` | yes | string · Component name to bake. |
| `theme` | no | string |
| `params` | no | object · Parameter values. Slot lists are arrays of instance literals. · map |

Not a `.pdl` declaration. Pass the JSON to `pdl bakePack` / `validatePack`.
